hospitals.name: MaineHealth Maine Medical Center Biddeford

Filters are path segments: /search/advanced-practice-provider-<specialty or facility slug>/jobs, e.g. -pediatric, -nicu, -barbara-bush-childrens-hospital; keyword query parameter not confirmed. Job detail URLs look like /jobs/<id>-<slug>. Internal applicants use Infor (hcm-mh-prd.inforcloudsuite.com).

hospitals.name: Connecticut Children's
hospitals.careers_notes: Connecticut Children's uses Oracle Cloud HCM Candidate Experience; the nursing careers page links Search Jobs to the connecticutchildrenscareers site and individual postings follow /job/<id> (for example job 2767). Oracle Candidate Experience pages are JS-rendered; use the REST endpoint /hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions with siteNumber=connecticutchildrenscareers and a keyword finder. The keyword search URL follows the standard Oracle pattern and was not fetched this session. APRN roles are posted here, including NICU roles staffed at Hartford Hospital and UConn Health.
